name: Northwind Platform — sales knowledge base
description: Product, pricing, competitive and playbook material for the Northwind sales agent. Fictional company used for role-play configuration.
out_of_scope_line: I'd have to check that, I don't have it in front of me.

passages.text: Northwind supports SAML single sign-on, SCIM user provisioning and a full REST API. SSO and SCIM are included on Business and Enterprise tiers, not on Team.
The reporting module includes scheduled exports, custom dashboards and a metrics API. Customers most often cite reporting as the reason they stay.
Native integrations ship for Salesforce, HubSpot, Slack, Jira and Workday. Anything else goes through the REST API or a partner connector.
Standard onboarding is four weeks. Data migration from a competing platform typically adds two to three weeks of customer-side effort, mostly rebuilding reports and re-mapping fields.
Contractual uptime is 99.9% on Business and 99.95% on Enterprise. Enterprise includes a named customer success manager and a four-hour P1 response.
List pricing per seat per year: Team 180, Business 320, Enterprise 540. Minimum 25 seats on Business and 100 on Enterprise.
An account executive may approve up to 10% without escalation. 11-20% needs the regional VP. Anything above 20% needs the CRO and a written business case.
A two-year term unlocks a further 8% and fixes the price for the whole term. A three-year term unlocks 12%. Multi-year is the preferred concession because it protects the renewal.
Launch-discount customers from 2024 came in at roughly 22% below list. Those discounts expire at first renewal and are not reinstated.
Where budget is the genuine blocker, a ramped deal is available: 60% of seats in year one, full count in year two, at the year-two rate throughout.
Meridian typically quotes 25-30% below Northwind list. They do not offer SCIM provisioning, their reporting is fixed-template, and their published uptime is 99.5%.
Customers who left for a cheaper platform and returned cite report rebuilding and the loss of API access as the reasons. Average time away was eleven months.
Never disparage a competitor by name. Compare on specific capability and let the customer draw the conclusion.
Establish the cost of the current state before naming a price. A number quoted before value is established becomes the whole conversation.
Price objections are usually risk objections. Ask what would have to be true for the price to be acceptable before offering anything.
Never concede without trading. Every discount is exchanged for term, seat count, a reference, or a case study.
A deal with one contact is a deal at risk. Identify the economic buyer, the technical evaluator and the eventual user before the second meeting.
